meta.purpose: SLATE errands research: fuel, EV charging, parking, store hours and Sunday trading, urban driving speeds for eight towns.

confidence.official: Read from the publisher's own page or data (AAA, gov.uk via its own figures, AA Ireland, CNE/Profeco, ESB, BC Hydro, Zapmap, NYC DOF/DOT, Dublin City Council, Westminster PDF, Sainsbury's/SuperValu/Giant Tiger/Price Rite/Smart & Final/CVS/Walgreens locator data, ontario.ca, Toronto Municipal Code).
confidence.secondary: Read from a reputable news outlet or aggregator quoting the publisher (CP24/McTeague, Global News, The Journal, Daily Hive, dcfctracker, Yelp-style listings). Marked 'secondary' per record.
confidence.null: Not found or not verifiable; never filled with an invented number.

notes: Fuel prices in autumn 2026 are high by historical standards (UK diesel ~198p/L, CA regular ~$6.40/gal); these are the published figures, not typos.
SLATE's GROCERY_CHAINS maps Price Rite to New Haven as 'nearestTo' (store is in Hamden) and The Fresh Grocer to New York: the only NYC Fresh Grocer is 523 Fulton St, Brooklyn (opened February 2026).
Several store locator pages (Tesco, Boots, Save-On-Foods, Shoppers Drug Mart, London Drugs) block automated reads; their hours here are secondary and flagged.

uk-eng-london.rule: Sunday Trading Act 1994 (England & Wales): shops over 280 m2 (3,000 sq ft) may open for at most 6 continuous hours between 10:00 and 18:00 on Sunday; must close Easter Sunday; Christmas Day closed under Christmas Day (Trading) Act 2004. Small shops (<280 m2) unrestricted. Registered pharmacies selling only medicinal products and medical/surgical appliances are exempt (Schedule 1 exemption; not fetched, verify).
uk-eng-london.observed: Sainsbury's Nine Elms, Camden, Whitechapel and Tesco Kensington all open Sun 11:00-17:00

ie-lei-dublin.rule: No Sunday trading restrictions in Ireland; stores set their own hours (e.g. SuperValu Aston Quay Sun 07:00-22:00).
ie-lei-dublin.source: SuperValu store data; no statutory Sunday trading law exists (the Commons Library note covers GB only)
ie-lei-dublin.citationNote: No primary Irish source fetched stating the absence; inferred from store hours

ca-on-toronto.rule: No Sunday restriction. Retail holiday closures: Ontario's Retail Business Holidays Act does not apply to Toronto (s.1.1); Toronto Municipal Code ch. 510 closes retail on New Year's Day, Family Day, Good Friday, Easter Sunday, Victoria Day, Canada Day, Labour Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. Exempt: small stores (<2,400 sq ft, <=3 staff, listed goods), pharmacies (<7,500 sq ft, dispensing available, principally pharmacy goods), gas stations, nurseries, tourist areas. From April 2026 municipalities may no longer require closure on Family Day and Victoria Day.

ca-bc-vancouver.rule: No Sunday or statutory-holiday closure requirement found; retailers may open on holidays if they pay statutory holiday pay under the Employment Standards Act.
ca-bc-vancouver.confidence: secondary for the 'no closure law' point

us-ny-newyork.rule: No general Sunday retail restriction. Alcohol: off-premises beer sales not permitted 03:00-08:00 Sunday; liquor stores may open Sunday (hours restricted by NY ABC Law).
us-ny-newyork.note: Alcohol hour detail from general knowledge, not fetched; verify before use.

mx-cmx-mexicocity.rule: No Sunday retail restriction; many chains open daily, some 24 hours.
